messages:
marta: Lodestar POC kickoff — they want to run Kite-65B (third-party) as a private deployment behind their VPC. Requirements: KMS integration, HIPAA, predictable latency SLAs. Asking for model catalog fit + pricing delta vs our standard 13/34B tiers. Any immediate blockers?
ryan: Kite-65B looks large but doable. Main unknowns: tokenizer compatibility (we need vocab/tokenizer mapping), KV-cache memory per-session, and if the model uses rotary vs ALiBi (affects kernel choices). Also: what quantization scheme do they want? q8_0/q4?
marta: Sales asked for a quick checklist they can send to Lodestar. Also they asked for a rough monthly committed cost if we run Dedicated A100s vs H100s.
tara: From infra side: for 65B we recommend 4xA100-80GB with KV sharding for steady throughput, or 2xH100 with nvlink for better latency. If they want single-region private deploy we can do it but need reserved capacity.
ales: Throwing a quick model config suggestion here for the POC (devs can validate):

```
model: kite-65b-v1
variant: lodestar-finetuned
quantization: q4_K_M
tokenizer: byte-level-bpe (verify vocab)
kv_cache_shards: 4
preferred_hw: A100-80GB
max_seq_len: 4096
expected_rps: 5-10
```

ales: If tokenizer differs we can add a mapping layer but it may impact perf.
r y an: quick note — if they pick q4 we need to run a quality baseline against the eval prompts. q4 can sometimes regress on long-context tasks. I can run evals if someone pushes the prompt set.
nina: Security heads-up: need the completed security questionnaire + model provenance docs (license, weights source, checksum). For HIPAA we must confirm no external telemetry and KMS audit logs enabled. Also need an approved DPA for Lodestar.
marta: Copying that — sales will get DPA/legal started. Can someone estimate the perf delta (latency/throughput) q4 vs q8 and A100 vs H100 for Lodestar's expected load?
tara: I can baseline perf on staging with a small sample — give me the model artifact (or S3 path) and a small prompt set. ETA 2 workdays.
ryan: I'll spin up a variant-scan job and tokenization check. Ping me when artifact is in staging.
deploy-bot: scheduled deploy job #DJ-983 on infra-staging for kite-65b-v1 at 2026-03-25T09:00Z (pending artifact upload).
marta: OK — action items: (1) Sales to share artifact + eval prompts (marta) (2) Ryan run tokenizer + variant-scan (ryan) (3) Tara baseline on A100/H100 (tara) (4) Nina collect security docs and DPA ask (nina) (5) I need a back-of-envelope monthly pricing delta for Dedicated reserved vs hosted for 65B (ales/finance). 20-min sync tomorrow? :thumbsup:
ales: I can prod finance for a ballpark today, will post numbers in this thread.
marta: Thanks all — scheduling 20 mins at 11:30 PT tomorrow. I'll drop calendar invite.
